text: Recent visitor feedback highlights issues with signage and accessibility, particularly for those needing handicap parking and shuttle service from the lot to the entrance. Several reviews criticize the use of AI in exhibits, describing it as poorly executed or detracting from the experience. Some visitors were frustrated by timed entry policies and wait times, which affected their overall visit. Food options in the café received negative comments, and a few noted that many displayed items are replicas rather than originals. Despite these concerns, the building’s architecture and interactive exhibits continue to receive positive mentions.
